_comment: Phase 2b acceptance targets (speaker identity quality), checked by
acceptance.py against a run_suite.py report from the Linux CPU
reference container, on top of every Phase 2a target
(phase2a_acceptance.json, which is checked as well). 'must' targets
block the baseline move; 'target' ones are reported. A missed target
is reported by how much, never relaxed here.

must: settled DER better than the pre-2a.note: Phase 2 starting point: 30 s window inside the caption tick

must: at least 97% of final words labell.note: finalized words that ever got a non-null label, probe run

target: speaker confusion at most 0.08.note: confusion term of the settled DER, as a fraction of reference speech

label corrections before finalization at.note: words whose in-progress label differed from their finalized label
